name: Ellen Weaver
source:
A Major In Section 6. Led The Assault on Legnitza Fortress. Commander of the Valkyries.

[spoiler]Although she starts out as a smart capable Major, by the end of her sexual and physical corruption, she is turned into a primitive, mindless idiot that can only think about sex.[spoiler]

[spoiler]The game confirms that Ellen is a lesbian.[spoiler]
